rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 50 hours Category I designated by AAPA, AMA, AOA Council on CME, AAFP or other ACCME-accredited organizations; remaining 50 hours Category I or II as accepted by NCCPA
rules.alternatives: Licensees who maintain NCCPA certification may show compliance by proof of current NCCPA certification for the period reviewed or audited.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after initial licensure; a license issued within six months of the renewal date is not renewed until the next renewal date two years later.
rules.carryover: Excess hours: up to 50 percent of the required hours (max 50 hours) may be applied to the following renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Certificate of completion of CE hours is attached to the online renewal; licensees may be selected for audit.

topics.who: PAs who prescribed opioids to a patient during the renewal cycle; CDC guidelines for prescribing opioids for chronic pain; counts toward the 100 hours
PAs who examine, attend, counsel or treat children in Iowa; HHS curriculum on child abuse identification and reporting completed in the previous three years (Iowa Code 232.69)
PAs who examine, attend, counsel or treat adults in Iowa; dependent adult abuse identification and reporting training in the previous three years (Iowa Code 235B.16)

rules.notes: Iowa now titles the profession physician associate. Compliance period and license period run October 1 to September 30 two years later.
rules.legal_basis: 481—Chapter 782 (rules 782.2, 782.3) and rule 481—780.8 Iowa Administrative Code; Iowa Code chapter 148C
